events.title: Apache Kafka 2.0 released
events.summary: The Apache Kafka project released version 2.0 on February 4, 2019 — adding self-balancing clusters and improved Java client APIs.
events.about: Kafka 2.0 matured the event-streaming platform microservices rely on — producers, consumers, and Kafka Streams for real-time pipelines. It cemented Kafka as the default log backbone between services.

narrative.whyChosen: Kafka 2.0 marked the platform's transition to enterprise-grade streaming infrastructure.
narrative.whyImportant: It expanded Kafka beyond a message queue into a full event streaming system.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams needed durable, replayable event logs between distributed services.
